visual_review: pass: Authoring assistant inspected physical pages 1–156 in rendered contact sheets and enlarged selected dense/changed pages; independent assistant inspected pages 157–306 with selected enlargements. All pages covered; no observed clipping, overlap, broken tables or missing glyphs. Minor continuation-page whitespace remains.
independent_review: pass: Separate nonhuman assistant reviewed manuscript claims and physical PDF pages 157–306. Final rebuild changed only rendered pages 15 and 74, re-reviewed by authoring assistant; pages 157–306 were pixel-identical. This is assistant review, not human academic approval or independent scientific regrading.
limitations: Automated bindings do not establish scientific validity, original-source authentication, or full source availability.
Recorded page count is not independently parsed by the standard-library receipt checker.
Neither review authenticates original provider records, resolves content decontamination, regrades experiments, establishes training gains or grants institutional approval.
Dense historical tables are retained; full-size PDF viewing is needed for their small text.
review_scope: Rendered layout and manuscript consistency, plus automated all-page text bounds, replacement-character, selected privacy-pattern and embedded-file checks. Pattern checks are not a guarantee that every possible sensitive value has been detected.
